categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' area label and modifies wallet transaction creation logic in src/wallet/spend.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents integer overflow, undefined behavior, and an assert crash when funding transactions with excessive recipient amounts. As demonstrated in the PR description, invalid amounts could overflow `recipients_sum`, causing an assertion failure in `RecalculateWaste` or allowing `fundrawtransaction` to succeed with wrapped output values exceeding MAX_MONEY.
